pictures.author: Diego Delso
pictures.observations: Golestan/western tower in its own Commons category: broad ocher roofless ring with weathered plaster/raw exposed patches, a low narrow arched eastern entrance, projecting block-like entrance landing and stepped/supported approach on a rocky separate hill. Fine wall wear is interpreted rather than copied.

pictures.author: Petr Adam Dohnalek
pictures.observations: Golestan category interior: dusty open court, irregular shallow central pit with coarse broken stone lip, scattered angular loose rubble, rough rubble enclosure. Pit is smaller than the eastern member; no roof or restored historic exposure-floor grid is reconstructed.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing western/northwestern Golestan dakhma at Yazd: separately mapped irregular broad ring with taller surviving roofless masonry and worn ocher plaster, genuinely open low eastern arched passage, projecting rectangular entrance landing and supported approach steps, gritty open court and smaller irregular recessed pit/broken lip/loose rubble. Four reused shared rubble/raw sandstone/stucco/gravel graphs. No intact historical tall tower, roof, bodies/bones, copied label/photo atlas, lower precinct buildings, eastern dakhma, complete hill or broad terrain slab.
